grammar.title: Back then with 当初
grammar.pattern: 当初，(主语) + 动词短语
grammar.explanation: 当初 (dāngchū) means "originally, back then" — it looks back at a past decision or situation, often used when reflecting on whether that past choice was right. It starts the sentence or clause.

sentences.pinyin: Dāngchū wǒ bù yīnggāi nàme shuō.
sentences.en: Back then I shouldn't have said that.
Back then he decided to learn Chinese.

sentences.zh: 当初我们都不知道会这样。
sentences.pinyin: Dāngchū wǒmen dōu bù zhīdào huì zhèyàng.
sentences.en: None of us knew back then that it would turn out this way.
